Messages.Author: Braddock
Messages.Body:
If I equip a minion with Inverarray, Scotland, and he takes an action to
move 1 blood on the card, from what source is the blood moved ?
From the minion or from the blood bank ?
Is the +X bleed permanent or just for the next bleed action ?

Braddock.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Braddock wrote:
>
> If I equip a minion with Inverarray, Scotland, and he takes an action to
> move 1 blood on the card, from what source is the blood moved ?
> From the minion or from the blood bank ?

From the vampire.

> Is the +X bleed permanent or just for the next bleed action ?

It is based on the counters on the Inveraray (and possession of
the Inveraray), so is "permanent" as long as he keeps the
Inveraray (since the counters aren't burned).
